Notes_and_Tips: Choose homemade meals most of the time and avoid deep-fried foods.
Since stress is a trigger, eat your meals slowly and avoid skipping meals.
Aim for 15–20 minutes of morning sunlight daily. Regular morning sunlight can help support your sleep cycle, energy levels and overall wellbeing.
Practice yoga consistently and try to include a 20–30 minute walk on most days.
Drink at least 2.5–3 litres of water daily.
Focus on consistency rather than perfection to achieve steady fat loss and improved body composition.
